facts.fact: 老报纸文章里的模糊照片：二十岁出头、蜜金发、雀斑、对镜头大笑——「不知道未来在等她」。
facts.anchor: The image is grainy, pulled from an old newspaper article.

facts.fact: 数周的考古式搜索：十年前的新闻、失踪人口报告、被遗忘的本地论坛。
facts.anchor: I’ve spent mine trawling through decade-old news articles, missing person reports and forgotten local forums.

facts.fact: 报案档案：十年前失踪、无尸体、无逮捕——更吓人的是，无嫌疑人。
facts.anchor: Vanished ten years ago. No body was ever found. No arrests. And more alarmingly, no suspects.

facts.fact: 男友当年曾被调查——旋即排除；名字没有见报。
facts.anchor: ‘It says that her boyfriend was investigated at the time but was ruled out almost immediately.’

facts.fact: 证据对齐：日期、年龄——「而且她长得，嗯，有点像我们」。
facts.anchor: The dates line up, the ages…not to mention the fact that she looks, well, a bit like us.

facts.fact: Blair 认出照片：Maria 家墙上那张被裁掉一半的合影——如今她看到了没见过的另一半。
facts.anchor: there was a photo hanging on the wall, but the other person had been cropped out, just like this one has been

facts.fact: 认知升级：她不只是灵——她是某人的女儿、姐妹、朋友；以为第二天会醒来、却没醒来的人。
facts.anchor: She’s not just a spirit, she was a woman, someone’s daughter, sister, friend. Someone who expected to wake up the next day and never did.

facts.fact: 门口站着的：失联多年的挚友——「Missed me?」
facts.anchor: Because, standing in front of us, is my long-lost best friend.
